name: VectorCraft

limitations: - OpenGL (AUTO, GPU): AROS One 1.3 and ABIv11 2026.09 have Mesa's software
renderer only. It works, but it is several times slower than CPU.

aros-x86_64-abiv1-pc.system: AROS x86_64, mainline ABIv1 (built against AROS 9802c8c0, 2026-10-28)
aros-x86_64-abiv1-pc.sdk: x86_64 mainline ABIv1 SDK built from AROS 9802c8c03c4797946b5a55621a23e2d904c5e126
limitations: - OpenGL (AUTO, GPU) works with Mesa's software renderer, which is slower
than CPU. Hardware OpenGL drivers have not been tested.

aros-aarch64-abiv1-raspi.system: AROS on Raspberry Pi, AArch64 ABIv1 (system image 2026-08-22)
aros-aarch64-abiv1-raspi.sdk: Raspberry Pi AArch64 ABIv1 SDK from AROS-20260822-raspi-aarch64-system
limitations: - OpenGL is off: AUTO uses the CPU, GPU stops with a message. It has not
been tested on Pi hardware, and under emulation it stopped the system.
VECTORCRAFT_EXPERIMENTAL_GL=1 turns it on at your own risk.
- Tested in an emulator only, with the keyboard; not on a physical Pi.
- One window. Floating panels open inside the main window, not as windows
- Every change redraws the whole window. On slow machines and in emulators
the interface follows with a delay.
- Letters typed with a keymap other than ISO 8859-1 can arrive wrong. File
and drawer names must be plain ASCII or UTF-8.
- The clipboard carries text only. File > Print saves a PDF instead of
- No automatic updates. The automation server (vectorcraft-cli mcp, the
--control port) and plug-ins have not been tested on AROS.
